title: Auroran (Desert Born)
content:
Aurorans were born in the desert and are Native to this terrain. Aurorans do not take a wound when they end their Action Phase in a Desert Clearing that does not contain a Civilization Location.

![](/images/pdf/7fa30bd52494c61660425707a3dd63b2dd04ac3f.jpeg)

title: Dwarf (Caver)
content:
Dwarves are very comfortable in caves. Dwarves do not lose an action for spending any part of their turn in a Cave Clearing.

![](/images/pdf/266e31b2777d2856070a952c049680684ec32366.png)

title: Elf (Magical)
content:
Elves are raised around magic and begin the game with an extra spell from the Hero Starting Spell deck. The selected spell must match the color of a Magic Cube they select for their Hero.

![](/images/pdf/e58dd7043dffd7517153100785ac79473fcb646b.png)

title: Gnome (Inventive)
content:
Gnomes are very Inventive and crafty, often creating their own items. After all players have selected their starting items, the Gnome draws 3 cards from the Item Deck and keeps one of them. Shuffle the unselected Item Cards back into the Item Deck.

![](/images/pdf/551e951225a84c38502f036f3436fb5ed3c35674.png)

title: Half-Elves (Two Worlds)
content:
Half-Elves straddle the worlds of elves and humans. At the beginning of the game, Half-Elves choose either the elven advantage or the human advantage to use for the entirety of this game session.

![](/images/pdf/c3d7dda5770a63f29ba0467eb08cbb327e94f2c8.png)

title: Half-Orc (Mountaineer)
content:
![](/images/pdf/8ba1056fa476d12bd5f8488c42c197ec2a1f1168.png)

Half-Orcs are very comfortable in mountains and do not pay the additional action cost to enter a Mountain Clearing.

title: Halfling (Stealthy)
content:
Halflings are easily overlooked due to their short stature and quiet nature. Halflings may reroll one Monster Die per hide attempt, except during the Cleanup step of combat.

![](/images/pdf/2c04a0439b2c0030a9e00962d25b6f72d0eb0f4f.png)

title: Human (Adapted)
content:
Humans are very comfortable in civilization and receive one additional free action during any turn they are in a Civilization Location.

![](/images/pdf/2231f1ae25446c024d6920eb27e6a6bd9c62eebf.png)
